about_the_game:
Operator Unknown is an atmospheric analog horror game about guilt, memory, and control. After participating in a project by the IReCorp corporation, you find yourself trapped in a virtual loop of foreign minds. On the edge of reality and madness — fragmented memory files, mysterious entities, and a voice calling from within.

Descend into a sequence of distorted memories and digital nightmares. Explore forgotten places, decode hidden messages, and try to uncover the truth: Who is IReCorp — and is it too late to stop them?


Warning: Game contains imagery that may be harmful to players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar condition.

  • Digital Nightmares

    Live through fragmented memories in immersive first-person levels. Survive long enough by relying on your reflexes and wit. Watch every corner of the room you're locked in and listen closely for every whisper.

  • Retro Aesthetic

    Explore environments with a unique artistic style and atmospheric storytelling. The town of Redwood has never looked so grim.

  • Flesh and Fear

    Encounter supernatural entities lurking in the dark — some eerily familiar, others beyond comprehension... and possibly a few clowns to make things worse.

  • Trust the Corporation

    Follow the instructions of IReCorp — or try to break free from a hopeless prison of ones and zeroes.
